detail.title: CP-KF86C
detail.overview: CarKam GPS with Cabin & Rear Camera, Hardwire Kit

General.Angle of view:
Front Camera: H-106°, D-139°, V-77°
Rear Camera: H-102°, D-124°, V-53.4°
Cabin Camera: H-125°, D-150°, V-65.4°
General.Image Sensor:
Front Camera: 1/2.8" Image sensor (0.9071 centimeters)
Rear Camera: 1/2.9" Image sensor (0.8758 centimeters)
Cabin Camera: 1/2.9" Image sensor (0.8758 centimeters)
General.Lens:
Front Camera: 3.0 mm,
Rear Camera: 3.35 mm,
Cabin Camera: 2.82 mm
General.Max. Aperture:
Front Camera: F1.5,
Rear Camera: F1.8,
Cabin Camera: F2.0
General.Compression:
Front Camera: H.265,
Rear Camera: H.265,
Cabin Camera: H.265
General.Resolution:
Front Camera: 8M
Rear Camera: 2MP (1920 x 1080p)
Cabin Camera: 2MP (1920 x 1080p)
General.Smart Features: GPS Logging, Voice Prompt, Time-Lapse , G-sensor, Parking Mode, Collision Detecon, WDR
General.Record Type: Audio Recording, Regular Recording, Parking mode, Time-Lapse
General.Speaker: Support
General.Connectivity: AP Mode (Dashcam creates its own Wi-Fi hotspot/ Direct Wi-Fi to phone)
General.Mobile App: CarKam (Available for iOS and Android Devices)
General.Dimensions (W × D × H): 108.5 mm x 45 mm x 45.5 mm (including lens)
General.Input Current: UPTO 1.6A Max.@12Vdc Input & at 2.4amp. max load
General.No Load Input Current: UPTO 06mA Max.@12Vdc Input & at No load output
General.Type C A8 PIN (Voltage and current): 5.0V/0A (4.80V to 5.20V ) Type C port no load
General.Short circuit protection: Input power shall decrease when the output short, the power supply shall no damage, and shall be self recovery when the fault condition is removed.
General.Over Current Protection: Output shall hiccup/ no load when the over current applied to the output, and shall be self-recovery when the fault condition is removed.
General.Low voltage: Battery voltage is lower than 16V, it is judged as a car, battery voltage is lower than 11.8V±0.2V for 3 seconds, the voltage reduction line will automatically turn off the out-put.
General.High voltage: Battery voltage is higher than 16V, it is judged as a large vehicle, battery voltage is low-er than 23.6V±0.4V for 3 seconds, the voltage reduction line will automatically turn off the output
General.Low voltage recovery conditions: Battery voltage is higher than the low voltage set value & ACC IN is input before it can be
General.Low voltage invalid: Battery voltage is higher than the low voltage set value & ACC IN is input before it can be
General.Aging test: Aged for 2 hours at full load in a normal temperature environment
General.Drop Test: Freely from 1.0m height onto the surface which is consisted of wooden floor, 6 sides, 1times each side
General.Input line (0.5m) Cable: DC Power V+(RED) & V-(BLACK) , ACC power (YELLOW)
General.Output Type C cable (2.8 meters): DC Power for Type C V+(RED) & V-(BLACK) , ACC for Type C A8 Pin ( YELLOW)
